applicability: The focus move applied after a selected subject's answer lands in the mounted workspace.
conditions: Focus moves to the rail's target-state notice when one is shown, else to the selected tree node, else to the reading-area column, and only when the active element is still the one recorded at selection time or has fallen to body.
exclusions: Scroll position after an answer, which follows the focused node in a real browser (O-R1-2).
statement: When a selected subject's answer lands, focus moves to the selected tree node -- or to the rail's target-state notice when the workspace shows one (a marker target whose family membership is unknown) -- only if the reader has not moved focus elsewhere since the selection (focus still on the selecting control or fallen to body); focus the reader moved while the subject was pending is kept.
